eden.tip.keys: Default keys: R class active, Tab card active (tap = burst, hold = burn), J talent starmap - all rebindable in Controls.
eden.tip.erosion: Erosion only climbs, and it bites harder each tier. Purifiers, oases and medic talents help - but leaving on time beats everything.
eden.tip.extraction: Return pods charge faster with everyone registered - and defending costs charge: the shield and life-support field drain the same pool.
eden.tip.purifier: The shop sells Purifiers: right-click for an instant -30 erosion. A lifesaver in the deep tiers.
eden.tip.market: Shop prices drift ±30% each game day, and one shortage good pays +50% on salvage - check the ticker before cashing out.
eden.tip.market_lock: While a crew is raiding, the day's market is frozen - your haul cannot crash before you bank it.
eden.tip.scanner: The scanner reads pollution and pod bearings - and every scan reveals one hidden affix.
eden.tip.cards: You carry 3 Curios card slots. Curse cards add Tab actives: burst, card-burn, ember lock - power at a price.
eden.tip.talents: Press J for the talent starmap: universal and class trees light up outward from the core; convert supply into talent points 100:1.
eden.tip.convert: Supply points are server-wide, but talent points you convert are yours forever.
eden.tip.oasis: Every raid hides one Hope Oasis: erosion pauses and recedes, with purifying supplies - the glowing light column marks it from afar.
eden.tip.core: Destroying a Pollution Core cuts server pollution by 2% - but the guard boss wakes to noise.
eden.tip.dragon: The Tainted Dragon in End expeditions is the apex bounty: -5% server pollution plus a chronicle highlight.
eden.tip.revive: Right-click a downed mate to revive - both of you pay erosion, and it gets pricier the longer you wait.
eden.tip.insurance: Buy an Attrition Policy before launch: failed-run salvage keeps 50% instead of 25%.
eden.tip.perfect: Flawless extraction +30%, sub-10-minute speedrun +30% - perfectionism pays.
eden.tip.solo: Solo expeditions earn a +20% settlement bonus, and the launch pad swaps classes on the fly.
eden.tip.locker: Ark lockers are private 27-slot vaults that persist across runs and restarts - don't haul your life savings into the taint.
eden.tip.chronicle: The Chronicle Wall is the campaign hub: server pollution, stage goals, records and highlights.
eden.tip.spectate: Admins can /eden spectate <player> to follow a raid live; spectators never skew crew scaling.
eden.tip.difficulty: Five difficulty tiers unlock with campaign stages: salvage pays better, endgame is the true abyss.
eden.tip.paradise: At 0% server pollution the Paradise Gate descends and the purified dimension opens to everyone.
eden.tip.greed: Curse cards always charge a toll: Greed pays +50% settlement but x1.5 erosion - think before you burn.
eden.tip.crew: Bigger crews mean tougher monsters (+8% HP / +4% damage each, capped) - but more hands charge pods faster.

eden.tip.sludge: Tainted sludge creeps outward slowly; standing in it stacks pollution and erosion - go around, or bridge over it.
eden.tip.eco_boss: Three ecology lairs hide in the deep taint: Spore Matriarch, Tainted Leviathan, Deep Excavator. Each kill cuts server pollution by 1% and drops rift-altar ascend materials.
eden.tip.rift_altar: The ark's Rift Altar forges cards: fuse three same-quality cards up a tier; boss materials + supply ascend a favourite card's stars.
eden.tip.acid_rain: High-risk runs can hit tainted rain: a warning sounds ~1 minute before it pours, and the open sky bleeds erosion - take cover when the alarm sounds.

eden.season.contract.survey.desc: Explore 300 blocks of natural cave passages (underground movement sampling).

eden.season.contract.lodge.desc: Spend one full game night inside a mineshaft or trial chamber.
eden.season.contract.haul.desc: Extract successfully with a settlement worth >=60 supply points.
eden.season.contract.purge.desc: Kill 3 ecology bosses or core guardians.

eden.season.msg.missed: Contract '%s' goal not met - no payout this run.

eden.guide.received: The EDEN PROTOCOL Field Manual is in your inventory - read it any time.
eden.book.title: EDEN Protocol · Field Manual
eden.book.subtitle: Issued by the Orbital Ark · Required Reading
eden.book.landing: Welcome aboard, $(thing)crew member$(). This manual walks you from your first drop all the way to the Paradise Gate.$(br2)The ark is home; the surface is the battlefield - $(o)launch into the taint, and take the world back, one inch at a time.$()
eden.book.cat.start.desc: The ark, the launch pad, and your first raid
eden.book.cat.raid.desc: Erosion, loot, extraction, settlement - thirty minutes of heartbeat
eden.book.cat.systems.desc: Cards, the starmap, the altar, and season contracts
eden.book.cat.campaign.desc: The shared purification war and the paradise endgame
eden.book.e.intro.p1: The taint swallowed the surface; the survivors retreated to the orbital ark. The octagonal deck you stand on hangs in the void: the $(l:eden:manual/first_run)launch pad$() ahead, the $(thing)shop$() and $(thing)rift altar$() flanking it, the $(thing)chronicle wall$() and your private $(thing)locker$() at the back.
eden.book.e.intro.p2: This is not a map you clear once and leave: every haul pushes the shared $(l:eden:manual/pollution)purification campaign$().$(br2)$(o)One run is a heartbeat; the campaign is a life.$()
eden.book.e.first_run.p1: $(li)Right-click the $(thing)launch pad$(): pick a threat tier (unlocked by campaign stage) and a destination (overworld / nether / end)$(li)Hit $(thing)LAUNCH$() and drop into a freshly-generated polluted world$(li)30 minutes on the clock: loot, crack a core, and come back alive
eden.book.e.first_run.spot_t: Your most reliable ally: reads pollution density, counts threats, points at the nearest extraction pod - and every scan $(thing)reveals one hidden affix$(). Sold at the shop for 45 supply.
eden.book.e.first_run.p2: Lost? $(thing)2-4 public return pods$() are scattered around the map - or deploy your own with a $(thing)locator$().$(br2)$(#ff6b6b)Remember: salvage only counts once it reaches the ark.$()
eden.book.e.keys.p1: $(li)$(thing)R$() - class active (taunt / triage / ore link...)$(li)$(thing)Tab$() - card active (tap burst / hold to burn)$(li)$(thing)J$() - talent starmap
eden.book.e.keys.p2: Everything is rebindable under $(thing)Options → Controls → EDEN Protocol$(). The low-frequency $(thing)"Did you know?"$() lines in chat make a fine teacher too.
eden.book.e.erosion.p1: Inside a polluted world your erosion gauge only climbs, biting harder each tier. Affixes, miasma pulses and the environment itself all say hurry.$(br2)Relief: the $(thing)hope oasis$() (erosion pauses), medic talents, purifiers.
eden.book.e.erosion.spot_t: Right-click for an instant $(thing)-30 erosion$(). Always in stock - carry one before the deep tiers, but leaving on time still beats everything.
eden.book.e.erosion.p2: At the $(#ff6b6b)30-minute hard limit$() the run fails - keep ratio 25% (50% with a policy).
eden.book.e.looting.p1: Under the tainted surface: essence, taint crystals, samples, relic shards, rare salvage... plus chests and monster drops. $(thing)Curse cards$() pay far better at settlement - and quietly stack erosion.
eden.book.e.looting.p2: Each run rolls $(thing)1-3 hidden affixes$() - only the first is revealed up front. The rest yield to the scanner, time, or the $(thing)Insight card$(). Fog closing in? Whispers? The anomaly IS the hint.
eden.book.e.extraction.p1: At a return pod:$(li)Right-click to $(thing)register$()$(li)Feed $(thing)eden cells$() / $(thing)taint crystals$() to raise charge efficiency$(li)Wait for the pool to fill - and launch
eden.book.e.extraction.p2: The charge-up is the real climax: $(thing)taint swarms$() every 10 seconds, and the $(thing)purifying shield$() converts damage taken into charge lost - $(o)defending slows your own launch$(). Registered crew also get a one-time life-support field.
eden.book.e.extraction.p3: Launch takes only the $(thing)registered$(). Flying flawless (+30%) or under 10 minutes (+30%)? The bonuses are waiting.
eden.book.e.settlement.p1: On a successful extraction everything convertible becomes $(thing)server supply points$(): shop currency, talent-point feedstock (100:1), the campaign's lifeblood. Gathering talents, the greed card and solo runs all pay extra.
eden.book.e.settlement.spot_t: Buy one for 50 supply before launch: failed-run salvage keeps $(thing)50%$() instead of 25%, consumed on trigger. $(o)Take the gamble - but afford the loss.$()
eden.book.e.settlement.p2: $(thing)Greed's Tail$() is the other wager: x2 settlement on victory, halved keeps on failure, -5% speed for everyone.
eden.book.e.market.p1: Ark prices drift $(thing)±30%$() every game day, and one $(thing)shortage good$() pays +50% on salvage. Buy low, sell high - check the ticker first.
eden.book.e.market.p2: While any crew raids, the day's market $(thing)freezes$(): your haul cannot crash before you bank it.
eden.book.e.ecology.p1: The taint is alive. $(thing)Tainted sludge$() creeps around cores and lairs; standing in it stacks pollution and erosion - go around, or bridge over it.
eden.book.e.ecology.p2: Three ecology lairs hide in the deep: the $(thing)Spore Matriarch$() (a witch on a mycelium mound), the $(thing)Tainted Leviathan$() (an elder guardian in a sludge pond), the $(thing)Deep Excavator$() (a husk king in an ore vault). Each kill cuts server pollution by $(thing)1%$().
eden.book.e.ecology.p3: High-risk tiers can roll $(thing)tainted rain$(): a warning sounds about a minute before it pours, and the open sky bleeds erosion - $(o)take cover, or go underground.$() Boss drops (spore sac / scale / claw) fuel the $(l:eden:manual/altar)rift altar$().
eden.book.e.cards.p1: You carry 3 $(thing)card slots$() (via Curios). Sixteen pure cards: gale, vitality, bulwark, aegis, insight, pathfinder... attributes to mechanics, each with a job.
eden.book.e.cards.spot_t: Built around $(thing)Tab$() actives: Bloodthirst's tap is a life-pact of true void damage; the hold burns the card into an ember lock... Power at a price - greed stacks x1.5 erosion, the glass cannon takes ever more.
eden.book.e.cards.p2: Packs come from the shop and drops; duplicates are never dead weight - send them to the $(l:eden:manual/altar)rift altar$().
eden.book.e.altar.p1: The violet altar on the ark, opened by right-click:$(li)$(thing)FUSE$() - three same-quality pure cards → one random card of the next tier$(li)$(thing)ASCEND$() - one boss material + 25 supply → a card gains +1 star (max 5)
eden.book.e.altar.p2: $(o)Duplicate epics and useless rares are just ingredients for the next legendary.$()
eden.book.e.talents.p1: Press $(thing)J$() to unfurl the starmap: the universal tree and five class trees light up outward from their cores. Supply converts to talent points at 100:1; switching classes never wipes progress.
eden.book.e.talents.p2: Five classes - $(thing)Engineer$() (emergency charge), $(thing)Prospector$() (ore link), $(thing)Medic$() (triage), $(thing)Vanguard$() (taunt), $(thing)Scavenger$() (discovery) - swappable at the launch pad. Large keystones also want an $(thing)ancient relic$().
eden.book.e.season.p1: Each season is a themed content pack - $(thing)Season One: The Deep Mines$(): go down. Carry at most one $(thing)contract$() at launch: Deep Survey, Vein Hunter, Relic Lodging, Deep Haul, Lair Purge - any class can finish; settle it by extracting $(thing)successfully$() with it.
eden.book.e.season.p2: Finish $(thing)3/5$() and the chronicle wall lights ADVANCE: the campaign resets, meta progression stays, a new theme arrives. One $(thing)focus contract$() pays +50% each week.
eden.book.e.pollution.p1: The $(thing)chronicle wall$() is the campaign hub: server pollution, stage, records, highlights. Crossing a threshold broadcasts server-wide - unlocking harder tiers and the nether/end expeditions.
eden.book.e.pollution.p2: Three unnamed energy bars on the wall explain nothing - $(o)they record the crew's own choices.$()
eden.book.e.cores.p1: 2-3 $(thing)pollution cores$() stand in the deep taint each run: approach wakes the guardian boss; destroy one for $(thing)-2%$() server pollution and a broadcast.
eden.book.e.cores.p2: Stage four unlocks the End expedition - the $(thing)Tainted Dragon$() is the apex bounty: -5% pollution, rich rewards, a chronicle highlight.
eden.book.e.oasis.p1: One $(thing)pure pocket$() per run: erosion pauses and decays, with purifying supply crates (the reliable source of Purity cards). The distant $(thing)glowing column$() is the beacon.
eden.book.e.oasis.p2: $(o)Catch your breath in the abyss, then finish the road.$()
eden.book.e.paradise.p1: At 0% pollution: the victory broadcast rings through the ark, the $(thing)Paradise Gate$() descends, and the purified dimension opens to everyone.$(br2)The campaign ends; the world you took back does not.$(br)$(o)- and then, a new season and a new story await.$()
